review.notes: All 24 physical pages' extracted text was swept with 5-gram shingle comparison against the OCR markdown (normalized: math spanned to placeholders, hyphenated line breaks joined); no code fences exist, all five tables export as intact HTML tables (Table 1's Janus row and other rows spot-checked against the PDF text), and the reference entries [1]-[60] match with line-wrap noise only. The printed appendix headings 'Appendix', 'A. Details of Semantic Tokenizer Mentioned in Ablation Study' and 'A.1. Architecture of Semantic Tokenizer' (physical p.14 top, visually verified on a 140-dpi render) were demoted to plain body text by the OCR while siblings '## A.2. Training', '## A.3. Integrating with LLM' and '## B. Additional Qualitative Results' stayed headings; promoted to the sibling '## ' level. Ref [23]'s URL underscore was confirmed on a 300-dpi render of physical p.19. Remaining shingle gaps resolved to: table-internal cell interleaving, LaTeX math spans, figure-internal text (Figure 2 architecture labels, Figure 8 multilingual prompts and Figure 9 demo Q&A are whole-figure or in-image content shown by the embedded figures), and per-image prompt captions that match the print's own truncated captions. No footnote bodies exist on any page (the (CFG) superscript 2 marker is retained by the OCR and no page-bottom body accompanies it).
